message:
Let me look at how the serializer handles the text content. The crash is likely in the libxml2 serializer when it encounters invalid UTF-8. Let me look at the `xmlBufAdd` function in libxml2.

<｜｜DSML｜｜>
<parameter=command>grep -rn "xmlBufAdd" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libxslt/libxslt/xsltutils.c | head; echo "---"; grep -rn "xmlOutputBufferWriteString\|xmlOutputBufferWrite" /workspace/repo-vul/src-vul/libxslt/libxslt/xsltutils.c | head</｜｜DSML｜｜>
</｜｜DSML｜｜>
